# Correctness verdict: PASS-WITH-NOTES

PR #186 at `880227b01abc6d7fce8d3677c0904798e09fee36`, answering `01a1ba57-d5c8-7d92-a6aa-e384fef5c4a7`. No blocking correctness findings.

The parser distinguishes absence from a malformed recognized line. It accepts uppercase `F` plus ASCII digits fitting `u64`, comma/whitespace separators and Markdown wrappers, merges lines and deduplicates numbers; lowercase tokens, prose, empty lines and overflow refuse rather than partially returning the accumulated list (`crates/core/src/claims.rs:344-380`). No `Fixes:` line produces an empty list and does not select F-coder holdings.

`pij delivered` parses the complete list before constructing/publishing its delivery record (`crates/daemon/src/http/claims.rs:364-397`). Therefore a malformed line returns `E-RS-FIXES` before recording delivery, releasing claims or ending holdings. The CI executable uses that same parser and treats an absent line as success for this check, then applies the existing `Delivers:` requirement (`crates/testkit/src/bin/delivers_check.rs:18-48`). Its executed test includes both valid no-Fixes bodies and malformed Fixes bodies; a legitimate no-line PR is not newly blocked.

F-item selection reuses the existing release mechanism: only lowercase `f` plus digits on a coder instance matches a named F number; `from < mergedAt` filters the selected holding, and every target carries its exact `from` (`crates/daemon/src/community/directory.rs:2103-2125, 2298-2303`). The writer checks that pin against the current open row under its lock (`:1975-1982`). Later assignments and same-seat/key release-reassign interleavings therefore remain open. PR-role and numeric-plan releases retain their prior behavior.

The PR template's optional comment, community route and coder packet all instruct authors to supply the line for F fixes without requiring it for other work. No new runtime loop, poll, timer or process launch is introduced; parsing uses the body already read and F releases share the existing batch commit.

**Proof:** clean detached worktree and FINAL at the requested SHA. Exact-head CI run `42464104904`, artifact `13611176783`, contains 2,237 passing Rust cases, zero failures/errors and zero reported skips. The strict parser, no-line CI checker, F-holding cutoff and F-holding from-pin tests executed. Author-run match-removal and malformed-ignore mutants failed their regression on the pre-merge source later committed as `0c4a6d56de0a0885bcdc978cd302fbd5b6bacb58`; the guarded code/tests are byte-unchanged at this head, verified by diff. Those were not mutation runs at `880227b`. No local reviewer builds/tests or product edits.

**N001, nonblocking proof ceiling:** the malformed-line fixture uses `Delivers: none` (`crates/daemon/tests/directory_http.rs:6587, 7535-7546`). Its refusal/HEAD/open-holding assertions do not establish absence of delivery rows or delivered events; the author confirms moving parsing after recording would be unobserved by this fixture. The current source ordering is correct.
